## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:平台测试清单里 platform-core 与 cli 两个区的 30 个条目改了步骤、夹具和验收口径,只动 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` 和 `cli.json`;另有 `cli-18-prerelease-db` 夹具配方补了一条已知缺口。
- 为什么改:18.4.0 验收跑时 QA 记下这些文字与产品现状不符(数量变了、入口挪了、夹具少一步),照旧文字跑会把正确的产品判失败或跑不起来;每一行都在 main 上按源码重新核过才改。
- 风险与回滚:只改清单文字,不动产品代码;每个条目升一版并加一条历史记录。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`platform-core.json` 的 `platform-core.notification-center`(acceptance[5] 改了比对的数据来源)和 `cli.json` 的 `cli.datasource-introspect-codegen`(acceptance[5] 改成未知数据源答 404 且非零退出);其余多为步骤和夹具说明。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Every row of the card got a disposition; all 32 were confirmed stale by source on `origin/main` 87330e89 and re-pointed, none was already right, none needs a live drive, and none needs a ruling. Each item is bumped one revision with one `history` row citing this card, the ledger row and the QA record comment. Rows 213 and 240 came over from #33331 (batch E) at the seat's direction; row 240's install-local part is the same edit as row 83, on the same item, under one revision.

## Tests

No test added or changed: the diff is checklist text. The checklist validator (`pnpm check:platform-checklist`) judges every `path#symbol` anchor the new text cites outside history rows, and all of them resolve. Nothing to ablate (docs are not ablated).

## Acceptance notes

- Every re-measure is from source at 87330e89, not driven live. Each history row says so, so a prior live verdict on a changed clause does not carry.
- Clause sentences changed in three items, each where the product's answer had moved: `platform-core.notification-center` acceptance[5] (the count now equals the pending approvals waiting on the user, compared against the `total` of the read the bell polls, since no door serves the my_pending count), `cli.datasource-introspect-codegen` acceptance[4] (the expected/actual pair prints only where the diff carries one) and acceptance[5] (validate of an unknown name answers 404 with a nonzero exit, no longer a vacuous ok), and `platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip` acceptance[12] (each of the 11 namespaces, access_policy added; it binds more, not less). Four more items changed only an acceptance `verify` (flag-command-error-ux [3], organization-ownership-ceremony [5], package-export-round-trip [5], stored-reference-package-backfill-upgrade [3]). The rest change steps, fixtures, personas, knownGaps, negatives, variants or the title only.
- `skip-changeset`: `docs/qa/**` ships in no package.
- `origin/main` moved 12 commits after the branch point; none of them touches either file.
